title: Vintage Fender Jazzmaster Value Guide: Prices By Year
description: Jazzmaster values from $4,000 to $18,000 across vintage sunburst eras. Compare gold guards, slab boards, CBS changes, custom colors and condition.
alt: Sunburst Fender Jazzmaster with a gold pickguard, white pickup covers and a vibrato arm

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Fender Jazzmaster Worth?
faqs.a: Vintage Fender Jazzmaster reference values run from $4,000 to $5,500 for typical 1970s sunburst guitars to $11,000 to $18,000 for early sunburst guitars, as of October 2026. Gold guards, slab rosewood boards and original custom colors attract additional collector interest, which a year alone won't capture.

faqs.q: Does A Slab Board Increase Jazzmaster Value?
faqs.a: Yes. Slab-board Jazzmasters attract a collector premium over comparable later veneer-board guitars. Original finish, pickups, repairs and the case determine how much of that premium an individual guitar retains.

faqs.q: Does A Refinish Change Fender Jazzmaster Value?
faqs.a: Yes. A full refinish removes the original finish that collectors pay for. The sunburst ranges assume original finish; a refinished Jazzmaster needs matching altered-guitar evidence rather than an automatic deduction borrowed from another model.

faqs.q: How Can I Get My Fender Jazzmaster Appraised?
faqs.a: Send clear front and back photographs, both sides of the headstock, the pickups, bridge, case and any known repairs. Keep removed original parts with the instrument and include the history you know. Those details support an individual appraisal.
